subject: food-technology
title: Vitamins & Minerals
meta_desc: KS3 food: key vitamins and minerals and their roles.
final_note: Small amounts, big effects on your body.

concepts.def: Helps healing, immune system, from citrus.
Mineral for strong bones and teeth.
Disease from too little vitamin C.

walkthroughs.body_html: Vitamin C is in oranges, peppers, kiwi. It helps wounds heal. Lack of it causes scurvy — what sailors got long ago. Vitamin D from sunlight builds bones.
Iron is in red meat, beans, leafy greens. It makes blood carry oxygen. Too little = anaemia. Calcium (milk, cheese, yogurt) builds bones and teeth.
Different colour fruits and veg give different vitamins. Aim for 5 a day — and as many colours as you can. Red peppers, orange carrots, green broccoli, blue blueberries.
